If local timezone is -3600 (west), time.timezone = 3600 (seconds west of UTC). Subtracting gives epoch -3600, then plus 1 => -3599. That's observed. So bug: using time.timezone leads to wrong result when local timezone not UTC; should use calendar.timegm for GMT.

Fix: replace time.mktime(... ) - time.timezone with calendar.timegm(time.strptime(...)). So modify function.
